## 1. Product Lineup

### Product 1: PIXPRO CORE (TLC SATA 2.5)
- Form Factor: 2.5-inch Internal Solid State Drive
- Interface: SATA III (6 Gb/s) (backward compatible with SATA II & SATA I)
- Sequential Read Speed: Up to 560 MB/s
- NAND Flash Type: High-Quality 3D NAND Flash Memory
- Target Use Cases: Laptop HDD replacements, desktop PC upgrades, office workstations, secondary storage.
- Key Technologies: TRIM support, S.M.A.R.T monitoring, NCQ, DevSleep low power mode, Garbage Collection.
- Warranty: 5 Years Limited Warranty.

### Product 2: PIXPRO EDGE (TLC M.2 2280 NVMe)
- Form Factor: M.2 2280 Single-Sided
- Interface: PCIe Gen3 x4, NVMe 1.4 Protocol
- Sequential Read Speed: Up to 3,500 MB/s
- Sequential Write Speed: Up to 3,000 MB/s
- NAND Flash Type: Premium 3D TLC NAND Flash Memory
- Target Use Cases: Gaming PCs, laptops, high-speed workstations, 4K video editing rigs.
- Key Features: Low power consumption, intelligent dynamic thermal throttling, AES 256-bit encryption.
- Warranty: 5 Years Limited Warranty.

### Product 3: PIXPRO FLEX (M.2 2280 NVMe 128-Layer TLC)
- Form Factor: M.2 2280 Single-Sided Design
- Interface: PCIe Gen3 x4, NVMe 1.4 Protocol
- Available Capacities: 500GB, 1TB, 2TB
- Sequential Read Speed: Up to 3,500 MB/s
- Sequential Write Speed: 2TB & 1TB: Up to 3,200 MB/s | 500GB: Up to 3,100 MB/s
- Random Read Performance: Up to 570,000 IOPS
- Random Write Performance: Up to 600,000 IOPS
- NAND Flash Type: Premium 128-Layer 3D TLC NAND Flash
- Encryption & Security: Hardware AES 256-bit Encryption, TCG Pyrite 2.0
- Read/Write Latency: Read: 90 µs | Write: 45 µs
- Queue Support: Up to 256 Queues, 1024 Queue Depth per Queue
- MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures): Up to 1.5 Million Hours
- Bit Error Rate (BER): 1 Error per 10¹⁵ Bits Transferred
- Operating Temperature: 0°C to 70°C (with integrated SMART thermal sensor)
- Operating Voltage: 3.3V ± 5%
- Dimensions & Weight: 22.0 × 80.0 × 2.23 mm | Weight: Up to 7.0 g
- Warranty: 5 Years Limited Warranty.

## 2. 5-Year Limited Warranty Policy Details

- Policy Overview: Every genuine PartPixels PIXPRO SSD comes with a Five (5) Year Limited Warranty starting from the original purchase date.
- Eligibility: Valid for the original purchaser upon presentation of a valid purchase invoice/receipt and serial number.
- Coverage Scope: Covers manufacturing defects and component failures under normal operating conditions.
- Resolution: PartPixels will repair, replace with an equivalent or higher-capacity model, or issue an appropriate remedy.
- Exclusions: Physical damage, liquid damage, unauthorized repairs, modified serial numbers, normal wear and tear beyond rated TBW limits, or secondary data recovery costs.
- Data Backup Notice: Users are instructed to maintain regular external data backups. PartPixels is not liable for data loss during warranty inspections.

---

## 3. Storage Knowledge & Technical Articles

1. Why Upgrade to an SSD?: Traditional mechanical HDDs use spinning magnetic platters (5400/7200 RPM) causing latency and vulnerability to mechanical shock. Upgrading to PartPixels PIXPRO SSDs reduces boot times from minutes to seconds, accelerates game level load times, and enhances battery efficiency.
2. SATA vs NVMe SSD: SATA III is capped at 600 MB/s bandwidth, while PCIe Gen3 x4 NVMe utilizes multi-lane PCIe architecture delivering bandwidth up to 3,500 MB/s-over 6x faster than standard SATA SSDs.
3. TLC vs QLC NAND Flash: 3D TLC (Triple-Level Cell) stores 3 bits per cell, offering superior write endurance (TBW), higher IOPS, and sustained write speeds compared to QLC (Quad-Level Cell) memory. PartPixels utilizes 128-Layer 3D TLC NAND for maximum reliability.
